import CategoryTheory.ProjectiveResolution
import CategoryTheory.Abelian
import CategoryTheory.CochainComplex
import CategoryTheory.LiftingProperty

open CategoryTheory

theorem lg_target {C : Type u} [CategoryTheory.Category.{v, u} C] [CategoryTheory.Abelian C] {X : C} (R : CategoryTheory.ProjectiveResolution X) : R.cochainComplex.IsKProjective := by
  let C' := R.cochainComplex
  let P₀ := R.obj 0
  let P₁ := R.obj 1
  let P₂ := R.obj 2
  let d₀ := C'.differential 0
  let d₁ := C'.differential 1
  let d₂ := C'.differential 2

  let f₀ : ∀ {Y : C} (f : Y ⟶ C'.obj 0), ∃ (g : Y ⟶ P₀) (h : P₁ ⟶ C'.obj 0), f = d₀ ∘ g ∨ f = h ∘ R.differential 1 :=
    by
      intro Y f
      cases R.isProjectiveResolution with isProj
      exact isProj.factorsThroughProjective Y f

  let f₁ : ∀ {Y : C} (f : Y ⟶ C'.obj 1), ∃ (g : Y ⟶ P₁) (h : P₂ ⟶ C'.obj 1), f = d₁ ∘ g ∨ f = h ∘ R.differential 2 :=
    by
      intro Y f
      cases R.isProjectiveResolution with isProj
      exact isProj.factorsThroughProjective Y f

  let f₂ : ∀ {Y : C} (f : Y ⟶ C'.obj 2), ∃ (g : Y ⟶ P₂) (h : R.obj 3 ⟶ C'.obj 2), f = d₂ ∘ g ∨ f = h ∘ R.differential 3 :=
    by
      intro Y f
      cases R.isProjectiveResolution with isProj
      exact isProj.factorsThroughProjective Y f

  let rec f_n : ∀ {Y : C} (f : Y ⟶ C'.obj n) (n : ℕ), ∃ (g : Y ⟶ R.obj n) (h : R.obj n+1 ⟶ C'.obj n), f = C'.differential n ∘ g ∨ f = h ∘ R.differential n+1 :=
    by
      intro Y f n
      induction n with n IH
      case zero :
        exact f₀ Y f
      case succ :
        exact f₂ Y f

  exact IsKProjective.mk f_n
